name: Jason (Paul's host in Thessalonica)
title: Hospitable Host and Faithful Co-worker
summary: Jason was a Christian in Thessalonica who welcomed Paul and Silas into his home during their missionary journey. He was arrested by a mob that accused him of harboring rebels against the emperor, but he was released after posting bail.

keyEvents.title: Welcomes Paul and Silas
keyEvents.description: Jason opened his home in Thessalonica to Paul and Silas, giving them shelter while they preached the gospel in the city.

keyEvents.title: Attacked by the Mob
keyEvents.description: Jealous Jews gathered a mob that stormed Jason's house to find Paul and Silas, but they did not find them there.

keyEvents.title: Brought Before the City Officials
keyEvents.description: Jason and some other believers were dragged before the city officials and accused of harboring people who acted against the emperor's decrees by claiming there was another king, namely Jesus.

keyEvents.title: Released on bail
keyEvents.description: After receiving bail from Jason and the others, the officials let them go free, which showed Jason's willingness to suffer loss for the sake of the gospel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Paul's coworker
keyEvents.description: Jason is mentioned along with other believers who send greetings in Paul's letter to the Romans, indicating his continued service in the early church.
